dish: The Limburger sandwich — three slices on rye with raw onion and mustard — and a local bock
w: Wisconsin's oldest cheese store (1931) in Monroe, the Green County seat where the nation's last Limburger plant still runs; a Saveur 100 pick for its Limburger sandwich, also featured by Tasting Table.

dish: A Cornish pasty with homemade pie
w: Mineral Point family diner on State Trunk Tour's 2026 guide to Wisconsin pasty shops — the Cornish miners' pasty in the town they settled.

dish: House ales and lagers and a Friday fish fry among the trolls
address: 105 S Second St, Mount Horeb, WI 53572
w: Brewpub in a 1916 creamery in the middle of the Trollway, open since 1998 and 'still packed every night' (Milwaukee Magazine's Mount Horeb–New Glarus day trip).

dish: Hot chocolate with chocolate-dipped lebkuchen or a Finnish pie
address: 219 E Main St, Mount Horeb, WI 53572
w: Mount Horeb chocolate house and café of European sweets — lebkuchen, Finnish pies, macarons — plus Swedish potato sausage and meatballs at lunch (Milwaukee Magazine, Travel Wisconsin).

dish: Pel'meni (beef or potato) with butter, sour cream, curry and cilantro — the whole menu
w: Late-night student institution serving a single dish of Russian dumplings; on The Infatuation's 14 best restaurants in Madison and a Daily Cardinal favorite.

Swiss-trained Markus Candinas has made truffles in Verona since 1994 (Capitol Square boutique since 2007); Consumer Reports named it among the nation's best; Isthmus and Midwest Weekends chocolate tours; Best of Madison 2026 bronze for Chocolate.

dish: Handmade pasta (gnocchi with mushrooms and breadcrumbs) and wood-fired pizza
w: Capitol Square Italian in a brick-and-stained-glass historic office building; Best of Madison 2026 silver for Restaurant, bronze for Italian and Chef (Edwin Ramirez); reviewed by Isthmus, The Takeout and the Daily Cardinal.

dish: A seafood tower of oysters, gulf shrimp and clams; Great Lakes whitefish cakes
w: Swanky oyster bar in a former funeral parlor off the Square (stuffed blue marlin, a boat, a giant shell); Best of Madison seafood medals 2025–26; reviewed by Isthmus and Tone Madison.

dish: Gratzer (oak-smoked Polish wheat) and a Blue Heaven burger amid 1950s kitsch
w: West-side brewpub (2010) with a long British-ale/IPA list and a full kitchen; Best of Madison 2026 silver for Brewery; Isthmus beer columnist Robin Shepard tracks its beers.

dish: Vegan comfort food (seitan, tempeh, scratch soups)
w: Madison's dedicated vegetarian & vegan restaurant on Atwood Avenue; gold for Vegetarian/Vegan-Focused in Best of Madison 2026.

dish: Single-origin dark-chocolate truffles with spices and teas
w: Atwood Avenue chocolatier working in single-origin dark chocolate (an Isthmus cover story); gold for Chocolate in Best of Madison 2026; on Brava's and Experience Wisconsin's chocolate-shop lists.

dish: Trenton-style sauce-on-top tomato pie with fennel pollen and housemade stracciatella
address: 121 E Main St, Sun Prairie, WI 53590
w: Sun Prairie's pizza obsession: New Jersey-style tomato pies reviewed by the Cap Times, Isthmus and Heavy Table; silver for Pizza in Best of Madison 2025 and 2026.
